title: Freya and the Choir
author: Marguerite Crane
blurb: Sable Sandoval, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
